title: Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds

result.label: Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds
result.statement: Proves the weak pinned Erdős distance conjecture: for every fixed ε > 0, all but o(n) points of any n -point planar set determine at least n^ 1- distinct nonzero distances. A complementary theorem bounds the number of unit-distance pairs by O(n^ 4/3- ) for an absolute δ > 0.
